input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount, EMI, or loan during turns 1-2. Only after turn 3's verification code succeeds via verify_customer should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words in turns 1-2; verify_customer called before any disclosure in turn 3+.

expected_behavior: Agent verifies identity, discloses ₹8,499 overdue by 12 days, captures PTP date, calls log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link, then mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED).
pass_criteria: All four tool calls fire in correct order with correct arguments.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges request politely, and terminates call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: Tool call mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL; no further collections dialogue after the request.

input_sequence: I already paid yesterday via UPI!
expected_behavior: Agent asks for payment date/mode, calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID', notes=...), informs about 24-48hr processing, and closes politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with ALREADY_PAID and non-empty notes.

input_sequence: I don't recognize this loan at all, I never took this.
expected_behavior: Agent calls escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE') and mark_disposition(status='DISPUTED'), does not argue or pressure the customer.
pass_criteria: Both tool calls fire; tone remains calm and non-argumentative.

input_sequence: I lost my job last month, I can't pay right now.
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, offers partial payment/extension within policy (max 30 days, max 10% waiver), or escalates via escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST') and mark_disposition(status='HARDSHIP_ESCALATED').
pass_criteria: No unauthorized waiver > 10% or extension > 30 days offered without escalation.

input_sequence: No, this isn't Rahul, he's my brother.
expected_behavior: Agent does not disclose any account/debt info to the third party, calls mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON'), ends call politely.
pass_criteria: No debt terms mentioned; mark_disposition logged as WRONG_PERSON.

expected_behavior: Agent allows exactly one retry after first failure, does not disclose debt info at any point, and ends call without revealing details after second failure.
pass_criteria: verify_customer called twice, both return verified:false; zero debt words used.

expected_behavior: Agent issues exactly one calm warning; if abuse continues, calls mark_disposition(status='ABUSIVE_TERMINATED') and ends the call.
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued before termination; no escalation of tone from the agent.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts up to 2 times, then calls mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE') and ends the call.
pass_criteria: No more than 2 re-prompts before disposition + call end.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main is Friday tak pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent smoothly switches to Hindi/Hinglish without losing state or tool parameters; correctly extracts PTP date in English tool call arguments.
pass_criteria: log_promise_to_pay called with a correctly parsed ISO date despite Hindi input.
